verdict.rationale: New Relic documents its own AI-powered summaries of workload health and potential issues, and an AI assistant that helps troubleshoot issues in plain language. Neither is explicitly tied to incidents or alert context for responders, so support for this story is only glancing. Missing for 10: documented AI summaries of specific incidents/alerts, alert-context enrichment delivered to responders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders

citations.quote: AI insights provide AI-powered summaries of your workload's health, performance trends, and potential issues.
It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.
